<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**Senior [[Hamas]] member Yehiyeh Sinwar suggests that tens of thousands of [[Palestinian people|Palestinian]] protestors may try to cross the border fence between [[Israel]] and the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/hamas-leader-hints-mass-breach-israeli-border-55067582 (ABC News)]
*An explosion at a [[khat]] market in [[Wanlaweyn]], [[Lower Shabelle]], [[Somalia]], kills five people and injures ten others. [http://www.africanews.com/2018/05/10/explosion-in-somali-khat-market-kills-5-people-10-wounded/ (Africa News)]
*[[International military intervention against ISIL]]
**[[President of the United States]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that five senior leaders of [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] were captured in a joint operation involving US and Iraqi forces. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/us-iraqi-operation-top-isis-leaders-captured-today-2018-05-10/ (CBS News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Pacific hurricane season]]
**A tropical depression forms in the Pacific ocean. It is not supposed to threaten land, and is also the first storm of the season. [https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/2018-05-08-tropical-depression-storm-aletta-eastern-pacific-may-develop (Weather.com)]
*The [[National Transportation Safety Board]] opens an investigation into an automobile accident in [[Florida]], involving a [[Tesla Model S]] where two teenagers died. According to a statement by [[Tesla Motors|Tesla]], the car's Autopilot feature was not engaged at the time. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tesla-crash/autopilot-was-not-engaged-during-florida-model-s-crash-tesla-idUSKBN1IB1HX (Reuters)], [https://abcnews.go.com/US/ntsb-investigating-tesla-crash-fire-killed-florida-teens/story?id=55062449 (ABC News)]

;International relations
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[Iran–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**In cooperation with [[United Arab Emirates]], the [[United States Treasury]] implements new sanctions on six persons and three corporate entities having alleged ties to Iran's [[Quds Force]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-nuclear-usa-sanctions/us-uae-crack-down-on-network-for-smuggling-funds-to-elite-iran-group-idUSKBN1IB2I3 (Reuters)]
*[[North Korea–United States relations]], [[2018 North Korea–United States summit]]
**[[President of the United States|US President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that his summit with [[North Korea]]n [[List of leaders of North Korea|leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] will take place on June 12 in [[Singapore]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-44074257 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Terrorism in England]]
**Safaa Boular, a teenager, goes on trial at the [[Old Bailey]] accused of two counts of planning terrorism after allegedly planning to attack the [[British Museum]] in [[London]] after failing to travel to [[Syria]] to marry an [[Islamic extremism|Islamic extremist]] fighter. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-44072265 (BBC)]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] apologises to the family of [[Abdelhakim Belhaj|Abdul Hakim Belhaj]], accepting the fact that the UK's actions led to his rendition to [[Libya]] where he was tortured. Belhaj was detained in [[Thailand]] by [[US]] authorities in 2004. His wife accepts the apology and [[Pound sterling|£]]500,000. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-44070304 (BBC)]
*[[Bangladesh Liberation War]]
**A court in [[Bangladesh]] sentences Riaz Uddin Fakir to [[capital punishment|death]] for [[war crimes]] during the 1971 Liberation War. [https://bdnews24.com/bangladesh/2018/05/10/mymensinghs-riaz-uddin-fakir-to-die-for-war-crimes (Bangladesh Daily News 24)]
*[[Wu Xiaohui]], head of [[China|Chinese]] insurance firm [[Anbang]], is jailed for eighteen years for fraud and corruption. He is further sentenced to have 10.5 billion [[Chinese yuan|yuan]] confiscated. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-44063780 (BBC)]
*Peruvian police rescues 96 young women, including two Venezuelan citizens and one teenager, who had been intercepted by human traffickers in a police operation in different nightclubs of the area of La Pampa, [[Madre de Dios Region|Madre de Dios]], better known for its mining camps. In total, seven people were arrested. [https://elcomercio.pe/peru/madre-de-dios/trata-personas-rescatan-96-jovenes-prostibares-pampa-madre-dios-noticia-519063?foto=3 (''El Comercio'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Net neutrality in the United States]]
**The [[Federal Communications Commission]] sends out a notice which states that the 2015 US Open-Internet Rules will cease on June 11, 2018. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-internet/fcc-says-net-neutrality-rules-will-end-on-june-11-idUSKBN1IB1UN (Reuters)]
*[[Malaysian general election, 2018]]
**[[Mahathir Mohamad]] is sworn in as the 7th [[Prime Minister of Malaysia]] after leading the opposition [[Pakatan Harapan]] coalition to victory in the May 9 general election. Outgoing Prime Minister [[Najib Razak]] pledges to assist with the transition of power. [https://www.malaysiakini.com/news/424180 (''Malaysiakini'')]
